title: Eddoboozi okuva mu nsiko eyaka
intro: Sumulula omuntu ow’amaanyi ennyo olugendo lwe lwe lwatandika n’okusisinkana okw’ekyamagero era ng’enkomerero ye yeeyungiddwa ku kusumululwa kw’abantu abaali banyigirizibwa. Omuntu ono ssekinnoomu yalondebwa okukola omulimu ogw’ekijjukizo, ng’ayolekagana n’okusoomoozebwa okw’amaanyi ennyo ng’awagirwa Katonda.
clues: Nnazaalibwa mu kiseera eky’okunyigirizibwa okw’amaanyi, ng’abaana abawere ab’abantu bange battibwa.
Obulamu bwange obw’obuto bwalimu okuteekebwa mu mugga omuzadde wange, naye ate nnasangibwa era ne nkuzibwa mu maka gennyini ag’omunyigiriza abantu bange.
Lumu nnadduka mu kibuga oluvannyuma lw’okutta omuntu ssekinnoomu mu butagenderera nga waliwo obutakkaanya.
Nnafuna obubaka obw’obwakatonda n’omuggo ogw’ekyamagero mu kifo ekitukuvu, gye nnalagirwa okusisinkana omufuzi ow’amaanyi.
Muganda wange yalondebwa ng’omuyambi gye ndi mu bubaka bwange, olw’ekizibu kye nnali ndowooza mu kwogera kwange.
Nnakulembera abantu bange ne basomoka ennyanja eyawukana, ne nsimattuka okuyigga eggye ery’ekibogwe.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
